text:
sophia: quick heads-up — i'm finalizing release notes for v0.9.3, target announce 2024-04-05 13:00 PT. need ops pin + canary lanes confirmed.

jen: sounds good. copying the microcopy snippets to the shared doc now. ping me when you want the short-form blurb. :memo:

tariq: can we pin the canary to v0.9.3-canary-2024-04-05 (no auto-roll)? we should lock that so dedicated doesn't pull the canary accidentally.

sophia: yes pin please. also we need rollback criteria in the RN: latency > 2.5x baseline OR 5% error rate sustained for 10m. keep it simple.

linda: ack on rollback criteria. ops roster for the window? i can be on standby from 12:30–15:00 PT. noah can cover 15:00–17:00 PT.

noah: yep i can take 15:00–17:00. i'm on call that day so fine.

ops-bot: [deploybot] queued: /deploy canary v0.9.3-canary-2024-04-05 -> staging at 12:45 PT. Reaction required: ops-ack.

jen: microcopy draft pasted: "We improved inference routing for mixed workloads to reduce tail latency. No customer-facing config changes. See migration notes for Dedicated users." want a 1-sentence TL;DR for the internal announce.

sophia: TL;DR: "Deploying v0.9.3 with routing and batching improvements — expect lower tail latency; ops will monitor canary before broad pin." keep it short.

tariq: ops pin request: set model_alias: redwood-llama-v2:0.9.3 -> canary pool only until 18:00 PT; do not promote automatically.

linda: confirmed. i'll add a one-paragraph ops note in RN about the rollback steps and the dashboard panels to watch (latency_p50/p95, error_rate, token_throughput).

sophia: great. jen/ops — final checklist for announce: 1) paste short RN in #product for preview, 2) pin canary alias, 3) run canary deploybot cue at 12:45, 4) ops watches for 2h, 5) if criteria hit, trigger /rollback canary -> previous.

noah: i'll create the deploybot cue and a short runbook snippet in the doc with exact commands: ```
/deploy canary v0.9.3-canary-2024-04-05 -> staging
/monitor dashboard release/v0.9.3
/rollback canary v0.9.3-canary-2024-04-05
```

ops-bot: [deploybot] ack from ops: linda, noah. Canary cue scheduled.

jen: i'll drop the internal announce copy in #product by 11:00 PT for review — include a 1-line ops note for support and a link to the runbook.

sophia: awesome. if nobody objects by 11:30 i'll hit publish on the internal RN and pin the canary. thanks team :tada:

linda: no objections from ops. :thumbsup:

tariq: good to go from eng-runtime. :rocket:
